intent: The keyboard shortcut hint shown at the end of a menu row.
typical_uses: The key combination that runs the same action outside the menu

dont_use_when.situation: A key or key combination shown in running text or a tooltip, outside a menu row

invariants.text: The shortcut is text only: it registers no key handler and adds no `aria-keyshortcuts`, so the application binds the keys itself.

dropdown-menu.module.css pushes the shortcut to the inline end of its row and renders it in the muted foreground color, switching to the accent foreground while a DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuCheckboxItem or DropdownMenuRadioItem holding it is highlighted.

good.title: A shortcut hint on a command

bad.title: A shortcut placed as its own row in the popup
bad.why: The shortcut belongs inside the row whose action it names; on its own it is a stray span that arrow keys skip and nothing ties to the item.
